description: A student-facing and research-facing collection of applied case studies using structural observation, declared envelopes, alignment, coherence, clarity, evidence, reproducibility, and governed agency without requiring the framework to predetermine the result.
purpose: Apply TriadicFrameworks and RTT lenses to concrete examples.
Preserve uncertainty, lineage, evidence, and alternative explanations.
Test whether the framework provides useful insight rather than assuming that it does.
Distinguish observation, interpretation, hypothesis, and speculation.
Provide reusable examples for students, researchers, humans, and AI systems.
shared_principles: Alignment must be evaluated within a declared envelope.
Clarity should remain proportional to available awareness.
Trust should remain proportional to evidence.
Models and simulations must not be confused with the containing reality.
Failure and null results remain evidence.

case_studies.title: Modern Scams and Misalignments: Developing Resilience Through Awareness
case_studies.primary_principle: Do not grant more trust than the available evidence supports.

case_studies.title: Reality Before Awareness
case_studies.primary_principle: Do not grant more certainty than awareness supports.

case_studies.title: Outlook is DOWN: What Microsoft Broke
Who Did You Pay for the Lightning?
case_studies.subtitle: The Last Person Who Remembered Free Energy
case_studies.primary_principle: Do not argue with the spark. Instrument it.
established: Atmospheric electrical behavior can be instrumented and studied.
open_hypotheses: Persistent site-dependent electrical signatures may exist.
Persistent signatures may predict differences in electrical reception.
Measurable reception differences may justify later investigation of collection and rectification.
guardrails: Current does not establish useful power.
Field magnitude does not establish harvestable energy.
AI pattern recognition does not establish experimental confirmation.
Large-scale energy implications remain speculative until experimentally demonstrated.

questions: Which relationships appear aligned or misaligned?
Does apparent coherence survive changes in observational position?
What observation would weaken or falsify the hypothesis?
What consequences follow from acting on the interpretation?
student_lens.goal: Develop structural awareness and disciplined inquiry rather than memorize predetermined conclusions.

ai_lens.role: Assist observation, comparison, evidence organization, uncertainty representation, pattern detection, and structural analysis.
ai_lens.not_role: Act as an unquestioned oracle of truth, safety, alignment, correctness, causation, or experimental confirmation.
requirements: Distinguish established knowledge from proposed instrumentation, hypothesis, and speculation.
Keep simulated or inferred structures distinguishable from observed structures.
Treat null results and failed predictions as evidence.
Prefer independently reproducible observations over narrative fit.

failure_conditions: Forcing evidence to fit the framework.
Confusing a model with the system modeled.
Confusing measured potential with available energy.
Treating AI-detected patterns as experimental proof.
Treating misalignment as automatic proof of wrongdoing.
Discarding null or negative results because they weaken a preferred hypothesis.
Allowing framework terminology to replace evidence.

stewardship.principle: Use the framework to improve observation, not to predetermine reality.
practice: Seek contradiction as well as confirmation.
Design observations capable of falsifying preferred explanations.
Act proportionally to available evidence and awareness.
